sentences.en: A lot of the content in Simon's books was actually heavily plagiarised content from other writers' works.
sentences.zh: 西蒙书中的许多内容实际上是大量剽窃其他作家作品的内容。

sentences.en: Once Simon's literary work had been exposed as fraudulent, his publisher demanded their investment back.
sentences.zh: 一旦西蒙的文学作品被揭露为欺诈，他的出版商就要求收回他们的投资。

sentences.en: So Simon fled overseas.
sentences.zh: 于是西蒙逃到了海外。

sentences.en: Not only that, Simon's move to England was only possible because he had conned one of his followers to hand over her savings to him.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，西蒙能够搬到英国，只是因为他哄骗他的一位追随者将她的积蓄交给了他。

sentences.en: He used the money to pay for the move, buy a new car, and for other expenses.
sentences.zh: 他用这笔钱支付了搬家费用、买了一辆新车以及其他开支。

sentences.en: As some followers began to turn their backs on their deceptive leader,
sentences.zh: 正当一些追随者开始背弃他们虚伪的领袖时，

sentences.en: Simon assured those who remained loyal that none of the claims against him were true.
sentences.zh: 西蒙向那些保持忠诚的人保证，针对他的所有指控都不是真的。

sentences.en: To maintain the illusion he was still an all-powerful spiritual being, he told his followers that his otherworldly abilities were manifesting each day.
sentences.zh: 为了维持他仍然是一个全能的精神存在的幻觉，他告诉他的追随者，他超世俗的能力每天都在显现。

sentences.en: He claimed to have almost entirely done away with his personality, that he was considering going into a state of complete silence, and that he was at such a
sentences.zh: 他声称自己几乎完全摆脱了个性，正在考虑进入完全沉默的状态，并且他处于如此

sentences.en: high level of consciousness that he no longer required sleep.
sentences.zh: 高的意识水平，以至于他不再需要睡眠。

sentences.en: Devoted online followers were convinced, but those who took the time to visit Simon in Glastonbury witnessed the truth.
sentences.zh: 忠诚的网络追随者深信不疑，但那些花时间去格拉斯顿伯里拜访西蒙的人却亲眼目睹了真相。

sentences.en: Simon was not gaining mystical abilities.
sentences.zh: 西蒙并没有获得神秘的力量。

sentences.en: He hadn't done away with his personality or gone into a state of silence.
sentences.zh: 他没有摆脱个性，也没有陷入沉默状态。

sentences.en: In fact, he was becoming more volatile and irritated.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他变得更加喜怒无常和易怒。

sentences.en: As for his claims of no longer requiring sleep, the truth was that he actually spent a lot of time sleeping.
sentences.zh: 至于他声称不再需要睡眠的说法，事实是他实际上花了很多时间睡觉。

sentences.en: Truth Fellowship defector Gene warned on his blog, quote,
sentences.zh: 真理团契的叛逃者让在他的博客上警告说，引述，

sentences.en: I would no longer recommend to anyone to get involved as I did before with the Truth Fellowship,
sentences.zh: 我不再建议任何人像我以前那样参与真理团契，

sentences.en: and I want to apologise here and express my sincere regrets to anyone who might have experienced any difficulties as a result of my initial recommendation of this group.
sentences.zh: 我想在这里道歉，并向任何可能因我最初推荐这个团契而遇到任何困难的人表示真诚的遗憾。

sentences.en: In the year 2000,
Simon decided to return his family, consisting of Deborah and their son, Chantelle and Justine, back to Australia.
sentences.zh: 西蒙决定将他的家人，包括黛博拉和他们的儿子、尚特尔和茹斯汀，带回澳大利亚。

sentences.en: They settled in a rented house in the beachside Perth suburb of Floreat.
sentences.zh: 他们在珀斯海滨郊区弗洛雷特的一栋租来的房子里安顿下来。

sentences.en: By now, Debra, Chantel and Justine were each participating in a sexual relationship with
sentences.zh: 到那时，黛布拉、尚特尔和茹斯汀每个人都与

sentences.en: Simon.
sentences.zh: 西蒙保持着性关系。

sentences.en: It was an unusual family unit, but the four adults involved appeared content.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不寻常的家庭单位，但涉事的四个成年人似乎很满意。

sentences.en: Everything changed later that year when Chantel fell pregnant.
sentences.zh: 当年晚些时候，当尚特尔怀孕时，一切都变了。

sentences.en: Simon was pleased, but his long-term partner Debra was not so enthused.
sentences.zh: 西蒙很高兴，但他的长期伴侣黛布拉却没有那么热情。

sentences.en: Conflict around the pregnancy resulted in Deborah leaving Simon and she took their young son with her.
sentences.zh: 围绕怀孕的冲突导致黛博拉离开西蒙，她带走了他们的小儿子。

sentences.en: Justine stayed through Chantelle's pregnancy but soon after the birth she began to reassess her life.
sentences.zh: 茹斯汀在尚特尔怀孕期间留了下来，但在孩子出生后不久，她开始重新评估自己的人生。

sentences.en: After seeking the help of a psychologist who perceived Justine's living arrangements as an unhealthy situation, Justine decided to leave.
sentences.zh: 在寻求一位心理学家的帮助后，该心理学家认为茹斯汀的居住安排是一种不健康的状况，茹斯汀决定离开。

sentences.en: The day she left Simon, Justine reported to police that he had physically threatened her but no action was taken.
sentences.zh: 在她离开西蒙的那天，茹斯汀向警方举报他曾对她进行人身威胁，但未采取任何行动。

sentences.en: Simon and Chantelle settled into their life together with their newborn baby girl, Leela.
sentences.zh: 西蒙和尚特尔与他们刚出生的女婴莉拉一起过上了平静的生活。

sentences.en: A short time later, they met a quiet, gentle, local man in his 30s named Tony Poppich.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他们遇到了一位30多岁、安静、温和的当地男子，名叫托尼·波皮奇。

sentences.en: Tony Poppich lived a nomadic life, moving from place to place, flexible to the vast possibilities of the world.
sentences.zh: 托尼·波皮奇过着游牧般的生活，从一个地方搬到另一个地方，对世界的广阔可能性持开放态度。

sentences.en: Described as a gentle soul who wouldn't hurt a fly,
sentences.zh: 被形容为一个连一只苍蝇都不会伤害的温柔灵魂，

sentences.en: Tony was easily drawn to Simon, whose dominating, manipulative personality was influential towards those of opposite traits, like Tony.
sentences.zh: 托尼很容易被西蒙吸引，西蒙主导、操控的个性对托尼这样性格截然相反的人很有影响力。

sentences.en: Tony became a devoted member of the Truth Fellowship, another server, which led him to joining the family fold, moving in with Simon, Chantel, and their young daughter Leela.
sentences.zh: 托尼成为了真理团契的忠实成员，另一个服务者，这使他加入了家庭圈子，搬去和西蒙、尚特尔以及他们的小女儿莉拉一起住。

sentences.en: Afterwards, the four moved to the small coastal community of Denmark, approximately 420 kilometres southeast of Perth.
sentences.zh: 此后，四人搬到了丹麦的小型沿海社区，大约在珀斯东南约420公里处。

sentences.en: In Denmark, they lived a quiet, isolated life together, focusing on preparing for the impending judgment day that Simon had been warning his fellowship about for years.
sentences.zh: 在丹麦，他们过着安静、孤立的生活，专注于为西蒙多年来一直向他的团契发出警告的即将到来的审判日做准备。

sentences.en: Chantel and Tony were fully convinced Simon's premonition was correct, and they were completely devoted to him as their leader.
sentences.zh: 尚特尔和托尼完全确信西蒙的预感是正确的，并且他们完全忠于他作为他们的领袖。

sentences.en: So in 2004, when Simon wanted them to pack up and move on once again, they willingly agreed to follow.
sentences.zh: 因此，在2004年，当西蒙想要他们收拾行囊再次搬迁时，他们欣然同意效仿。

sentences.en: The group's next location was the small timber milling town of Nanup, three hours south of Perth.
sentences.zh: 该团体的下一个落脚点是纳农普，这是一个位于珀斯以南三小时车程的小型木材加工小镇。

sentences.en: Sitting along the banks of the Blackwood River, the longest continually flowing river in Western
sentences.zh: 纳农普坐落于西澳大利亚州

sentences.en: Australia, Nanup is a small town built around the timber trade and beef farming.
sentences.zh: 最长常流河黑伍德河的河畔，是一个围绕木材贸易和肉牛养殖建立的小镇。

sentences.en: With a local population of around 500 residents, Nanup has always had a strong arts feel and residents are proud of the gardens and local artistic community.
sentences.zh: 纳农普当地人口约为 500 人，一直以来都弥漫着浓厚的艺术气息，居民们对这里的花园和当地的艺术社群感到自豪。

sentences.en: Its main street has Victorian-style weatherboard shops and cafes framed by bullnose verandas sheltering the footpaths below from the sweltering sun.
sentences.zh: 其主街两旁是维多利亚风格的木板商店和咖啡馆，外围有弧形游廊，为下方的人行道遮挡着酷热的阳光。

sentences.en: By far, the most striking thing about Nanup is that it's nestled right in the southern forest region, surrounded 360 degrees by forests and national parks.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，纳农普最引人注目的地方在于它坐落在南部的森林腹地，周围 360 度环绕着森林和国家公园。

sentences.en: Packed inside are giant eucalyptus trees, some of which are upwards of 400 years old, 90 metres tall, and take nine people all holding hands to span their girth.
sentences.zh: 里面长满了巨大的桉树，其中一些树龄在 400 年以上，高达 90 米，需要九个人手拉手才能合抱过来。

sentences.en: The forests are dense with shrubbery and shadowed by leafy canopies.
sentences.zh: 森林里灌木丛生，绿树成荫，树冠遮天蔽日。

sentences.en: Narrow-pressed dirt walking tracks weave throughout, trailing off for hours.
sentences.zh: 压实的小泥路在其中纵横交错，延伸数小时之久。

sentences.en: all you can see are trees and scrub in every direction, as far as the eye can see.
sentences.zh: 放眼望去，四面八方全都是树木和灌木，一望无际。

sentences.en: It can be impossible to know which direction is which, forward, back, side to side, it can all look the same.
sentences.zh: 你可能会分不清东南西北、前后左右，一切看起来都一模一样。

sentences.en: Disorientation can get the better of you, and with the forest floor carpeted with shrubs and ferns, you're told to never deviate from the trails.
sentences.zh: 迷失感可能会战胜你的理智，而且由于林地铺满了灌木和蕨类植物，人们被告知千万不要偏离小路。

sentences.en: If you go too far off track, you might not be able to find your way back.
sentences.zh: 如果你偏离主路太远，可能就再也找不回去了。

sentences.en: Simon found this sense of remoteness and isolation appealing.
sentences.zh: 西蒙觉得这种远离尘世的孤立感十分吸引人。

sentences.en: Nanup felt like a quiet, secluded, private place, somewhere the family would not be easily found.
sentences.zh: 纳农普给人一种安静、隐秘、私密的感觉，是个不轻易能找到这家人所在的地方。

sentences.en: He settled his family into a blue fibro house on a beef farm property run by their landlords, 10km south of Nanup's town centre.
sentences.zh: 他在纳农普镇中心以南 10 公里处的一处房东经营的养牛场里，把家人安顿在一栋蓝色的纤维水泥板房子里。

sentences.en: The house was set back from the road and hidden amongst looming gum trees.
sentences.zh: 这栋房子从路边退后，隐蔽在郁郁葱葱的桉树之中。

sentences.en: It was picturesque Australian country living.
sentences.zh: 这是一幅风景如画的澳大利亚乡村生活画面。

sentences.en: The front yard was colourfully lined with native Australian plants.
sentences.zh: 前院种满了色彩斑斓的澳大利亚本土植物。

sentences.en: They raised chickens and two long-haired dachshund dogs.
sentences.zh: 他们养了鸡和两只长毛腊肠犬。

sentences.en: Simon, Chantelle and young Leela lived in the main house and Tony lived in a caravan sheltered by a tin shed out the back of the property.
sentences.zh: 西蒙、尚特尔和年幼的莉拉住在主屋里，托尼则住在房子后方一个被铁皮棚遮蔽的大篷车里。

sentences.en: In the backyard, Simon grew a vine known scientifically as Banisteriopsis carpi, used to make the brew ayahuasca, a potent hallucinogenic potion well known in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 在后院里，西蒙种植了一种在科学上被称为死藤水藤本植物的藤蔓，用于制作死藤水——这是一种在巴西广为人知的强效致幻剂。

sentences.en: In Brazilian culture, the brew was a traditional spiritual medicine used in ceremonies and rituals among the indigenous people of the Amazon Basin.
sentences.zh: 在巴西文化中，这种饮料是一种传统的精神药物，用于亚马逊盆地原住民的仪式和庆典中。

sentences.en: Although the usage varies, ayahuasca was often consumed to provide a hallucinogenic experience aimed to find clarity and life's meaning.
sentences.zh: 尽管用法各不相同，但饮用死藤水通常是为了获得致幻体验，旨在寻找清晰的思路和生命的意义。

sentences.en: These hallucinations are often emotional and psychologically stressful, with physical purging a common side effect.
sentences.zh: 这些幻觉往往伴随着情绪和心理上的压力，身体净化则是常见的副作用。

sentences.en: Simon believed he would find his own spiritual clarity by consuming ayahuasca and it would later help prepare his family for the impending judgment day.
sentences.zh: 西蒙坚信，通过饮用死藤水，他能找到自己精神上的清明，并且这将在日后帮助他的家人为即将到来的审判日做好准备。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: “案件档案”节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持“案件档案”继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: By 2007, the family were still preparing for the end of the world.
sentences.zh: 到 2007 年，这家人仍在为世界末日做准备。

sentences.en: At the time, Simon didn't work, instead spending most of his time on the computer communicating with his few Truth Fellowship devotees.
sentences.zh: 当时，西蒙没有工作，而是把大部分时间都花在电脑上，与他为数不多的真理团契信徒交流。

sentences.en: In the meantime,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Chantel and Tony worked to provide the family income.
sentences.zh: 尚特尔和托尼工作来维持家庭收入。

sentences.en: Tony worked at the local hardware store in town.
sentences.zh: 托尼在镇上的当地五金店工作。

sentences.en: Colleagues and customers considered him a hard-working and friendly employee.
sentences.zh: 同事和顾客都认为他是一个勤劳友善的员工。

sentences.en: His gentle temperament adapted well to the slow-paced lifestyle of the small country town.
sentences.zh: 他温和的性格很适应乡村小镇慢节奏的生活方式。

sentences.en: Chantelle worked in the local fish and chip shop, the local pub, and taught swimming at the local pool.
sentences.zh: 尚特尔曾在当地的炸鱼薯条店和当地酒吧工作，还在当地的游泳池教游泳。

sentences.en: She remained as she had always been known, an outgoing, spirited, and loving friend and mother who was well-liked within the local community.
sentences.zh: 她依然一如既往地为人所知，是个外向、热情、充满爱心的朋友和母亲，在当地社区很受欢迎。

sentences.en: However, others were acutely aware that wherever
sentences.zh: 然而，其他人敏锐地发现，无论

sentences.en: Chantelle was, Simon wasn't far behind.
sentences.zh: 尚特尔在哪里，西蒙就紧随其后。

sentences.en: When Chantelle was working at the fish and chip shop, others would spot Simon sitting in his car parked outside.
sentences.zh: 当尚特尔在炸鱼薯条店工作时，其他人会看到西蒙坐在停在外面的车里。

sentences.en: When she worked at the pub,
sentences.zh: 当她在酒吧工作时，

sentences.en: Simon would be there too, sitting at the bar watching her.
sentences.zh: 西蒙也会在那里，坐在吧台前看着她。

sentences.en: The tension Simon radiated was palpable.
sentences.zh: 西蒙身上散发出的紧张感显而易见。

sentences.en: He projected his reclusive insecurities onto her.
sentences.zh: 他将自己离群索居的不安全感投射到她身上。

sentences.en: He didn't like Chantel talking to anyone.
sentences.zh: 他不喜欢尚特尔和任何人说话。

sentences.en: Despite Chantel's ongoing devotion to him, her workmates felt that within that love was a simmering fear.
sentences.zh: 尽管尚特尔对她依旧忠心耿耿，但她的同事们觉得，在这份爱意背后潜藏着一种恐惧。

sentences.en: Their six-year-old daughter Leela was a happy kid who inherited her mother's friendliness.
sentences.zh: 他们六岁的女儿莉拉是个快乐的孩子，继承了母亲的友好。

sentences.en: Even though she was being homeschooled, Leela was naturally outgoing.
sentences.zh: 尽管她一直在家接受教育，但莉拉天性外向。

sentences.en: She could make friends easily and had no trouble talking to different people.
sentences.zh: 她很容易交到朋友，与不同的人聊天也毫无困难。

sentences.en: She was naturally funny, loud and inquisitive.
sentences.zh: 她天生幽默、声音洪亮且充满好奇心。

sentences.en: Unlike her father, Leela embraced attention and loved to dance around the room.
sentences.zh: 与父亲不同，莉拉喜欢成为焦点，也喜欢在房间里翩翩起舞。

sentences.en: As for Simon, other than the times he was spotted loitering around Chantal's workplaces, locals rarely saw him.
sentences.zh: 至于西蒙，除了偶尔被发现在尚特尔的工作场所附近闲逛之外，当地人很少见到他。

sentences.en: He was an introverted homebody.
sentences.zh: 他是个内向的宅男。

sentences.en: But that in itself wasn't particularly concerning.
sentences.zh: 但这本身并没有什么特别令人担忧的。

sentences.en: The Australian countryside drew in quiet, reserved folk who valued the rural, reclusive life.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的乡村吸引着那些重视农村隐居生活的安静、内向的人们。

sentences.en: What the locals did know of
sentences.zh: 当地人对

sentences.en: Simon was that he was an alternative thinker who had a very particular set of beliefs.
sentences.zh: 西蒙的了解是，他是一个有着非常独特信仰体系的另类思考者。

sentences.en: But none had extensive knowledge of his online cult or of his doomsday premonitions.
sentences.zh: 但没有人对他的网络邪教或末日预言有深入的了解。

sentences.en: By the beginning of 2007, Chantel had dedicated almost a decade of her life to Simon.
sentences.zh: 到 2007 年初，尚特尔已经将她生命中近十年的时间奉献给了西蒙。

sentences.en: Her parents, Jim and Kath McDougall, lived thousands of kilometres east on the Victorian and New South Wales border.
sentences.zh: 她的父母吉姆和凯斯·麦克杜格尔住在数千公里以东的维多利亚州和新南威尔士州边界。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, they aimed to visit their daughter in Nanup at least once a year.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们仍计划每年至少去纳农普探望女儿一次。

sentences.en: Jim and Kath weren't fully aware of Simon Cadwell's intense spiritual beliefs.
sentences.zh: 吉姆和凯斯并不完全了解西蒙·卡德维尔强烈的精神信仰。

sentences.en: They didn't know about the Truth Fellowship, Judgment Day, or the extent in which he had brainwashed their daughter.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道真理团契、审判日，也不知道他给女儿洗脑到了什么程度。

sentences.en: As far as they were concerned, Simon and Chantel were just spiritual freethinkers who had a different, albeit somewhat weird, belief system.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，西蒙和尚特尔只是精神自由思想者，拥有一套与众不同、尽管有点怪异的信仰体系。

sentences.en: They did, however, pick up on
sentences.zh: 不过，他们确实察觉到了

sentences.en: Simon's controlling nature.
sentences.zh: 西蒙的控制欲。

sentences.en: When they visited Nanab, Jim and Kath didn't stay in the family house.
sentences.zh: 当他们访问纳农普时，吉姆和凯斯并没有住在家庭住宅里。

sentences.en: Instead, they would stay in a nearby cabin.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们会住在附近的小木屋里。

sentences.en: When they'd visit their daughter's house,
sentences.zh: 当他们去女儿家拜访时，

2007, it had been three months since the family had abandoned the Nanup property.
sentences.zh: 10月，距离这家人抛弃纳纳普的房产已经过去三个月了。

sentences.en: There had been no news of or from Simon, Chantel, Leela or Tony.
sentences.zh: 没有任何关于或来自西蒙、尚泰尔、莉拉或托尼的消息。

sentences.en: Chantel McDougal and her daughter Leela were officially listed as missing persons.
sentences.zh: 尚泰尔·麦克杜格尔和她的女儿莉拉被正式列为失踪人员。

sentences.en: Police arrived at their old Nanup house to conduct a search for clues as to the family's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 警察来到他们旧的纳纳普住所进行搜查，寻找关于这家人下落的线索。

sentences.en: Upon arrival, they discovered that in the previous months, the landlords had thoroughly cleaned the house and it was now being rented out to new tenants.
sentences.zh: 到达后，他们发现房东在过去的几个月里已经彻底清洁了房子，现在正出租给新租客。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, a thorough search of the property and its surrounds was conducted, but nothing of note was found.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警方还是对该物业及其周边进行了彻底搜查，但没有发现任何值得注意的东西。

sentences.en: The bank accounts of Simon, Chantel and Tony had not been touched since the time of their supposed trip to Brazil.
sentences.zh: 自他们所谓去巴西的行程开始以来，西蒙、尚泰尔和托尼的银行账户一直未被动过。

sentences.en: Chantel's account still held the
sentences.zh: 尚泰尔的账户里依然存着

sentences.en: $4,000 she had been paid for her car, as well as the money for selling the two dogs.
sentences.zh: 卖车所得的4000美元，以及卖掉两只狗的钱。

sentences.en: Government services the family had access to, including social security payments and public health care, had not been recently used.
sentences.zh: 该家庭可以使用的政府服务，包括社会保障金和公共医疗保健，最近都没有被使用过。

sentences.en: This only raised more questions about the authenticity of the Brazil story.
sentences.zh: 这引发了对巴西故事真实性的更多疑问。

sentences.en: Had the family really gone overseas, they would have needed money to do that.
sentences.zh: 如果这家人真的去了海外，他们需要钱才能做到这一点。

sentences.en: They sold their cars and their dogs to ensure they had money
sentences.zh: 他们卖掉了汽车和狗以确保自己有钱

sentences.en: Yet, it had been left untouched
sentences.zh: 然而，这些钱却纹丝未动

sentences.en: In the meantime, Chantel's parents weren't the only ones attempting to locate the family
sentences.zh: 与此同时，寻找这家人的不只有尚泰尔的父母

sentences.en: By November 2007, Tony Poppich had been reported as a missing person as well
sentences.zh: 到2007年11月，托尼·波皮奇也被报告为失踪人员

sentences.en: Tony's father and brother had no clue where Tony was It was already difficult for them to track Tony in normal circumstances as he lived a nomadic lifestyle
sentences.zh: 托尼的父亲和兄弟根本不知道托尼在哪里。由于他过着游牧般的生活，在正常情况下追踪他本就很艰难

sentences.en: Regardless, he always kept in touch, so it was out of character for him to vanish without a trace.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，他总是保持联系，因此他无声无息地消失很不符合他的性格。

sentences.en: Tony's father told police that he had recently given Tony $25,000 to take care of what he thought was a legal matter.
sentences.zh: 托尼的父亲告诉警方，他最近给了托尼25000美元，用于处理他认为是一起法律事务的事情。

sentences.en: But where exactly that money went, he had no clue.
sentences.zh: 但这笔钱究竟去了哪里，他毫无头绪。

sentences.en: Tony's brother,
sentences.zh: 托尼的兄弟

sentences.en: Joe Poppich, had his concerns about Simon Cadwell.
sentences.zh: 乔·波皮奇对西蒙·卡德威尔有所担忧。

sentences.en: Joe knew of Simon's alternative lifestyle and believed the Truth Fellowship had all the hallmarks of a cult.
sentences.zh: 乔了解西蒙另类的生活方式，并认为真理团契具备邪教的所有特征。

sentences.en: Simon Cadwell was the leader and he demanded full obedience from his followers, including Chantel, Leela and Tony.
sentences.zh: 西蒙·卡德威尔是领导者，他要求信徒们绝对服从，包括尚泰尔、莉拉和托尼。

sentences.en: Simon had even once tried to recruit Joe as another server in the Truth Fellowship.
sentences.zh: 西蒙甚至曾试图招募乔作为真理团契的另一名服务人员。

sentences.en: Joe didn't buy into it, but his brother Tony did.
sentences.zh: 乔不吃这一套，但他的兄弟托尼信了。

sentences.en: When Tony went missing, Joe was convinced Simon relocated the family to an isolated commune where they couldn't be found, likely a remote area of Australia.
sentences.zh: 当托尼失踪时，乔确信西蒙把这家人转移到了一个无法找到他们的偏僻公社，很可能是澳大利亚的一个偏远地区。

sentences.en: When Joe attempted to get information from other members of the Truth Fellowship to help find his brother, they were not forthcoming.
sentences.zh: 当乔试图从真理团契的其他成员那里获取信息以帮助寻找他的兄弟时，他们并不配合。

sentences.en: As the search for the family continued, Simon's online activity was thoroughly investigated.
sentences.zh: 随着对这家人搜寻的持续，西蒙的网络活动受到了彻底调查。

sentences.en: He hadn't been active since the disappearance, but his online blog held some concerning secrets.
sentences.zh: 自从失踪以来他一直没有活动，但他的网络博客隐藏了一些令人担忧的秘密。

sentences.en: Just over two weeks before Simon and his family disappeared, he wrote on his blog, quote, I'm exhausted and the only option is to leave this world.
sentences.zh: 就在西蒙和他的家人失踪两周多前，他在博客中写道，原话是：“我筋疲力尽，唯一的选择就是离开这个世界。”

sentences.en: One of his American followers, a woman named Sharon, reached out.
sentences.zh: 他的一位美国信徒，一个名叫莎伦的女人联系了他。

sentences.en: Simon revealed he was considering obtaining the drug Nembutel, a central nervous system depressant that is widely used in euthanasia and suicide.
sentences.zh: 西蒙透露他正在考虑获取戊巴比妥这种药物，这是一种中枢神经系统抑制剂，广泛用于安乐死和自杀。

sentences.en: Simon confessed the purpose of obtaining the drug was to give it to his family.
sentences.zh: 西蒙坦白获取这种药物的目的是为了给他的家人。

sentences.en: Simon planned to administer the lethal drugs to
sentences.zh: 西蒙计划将致死药物注射给

sentences.en: Chantel, Leela, and then himself.
sentences.zh: 尚泰尔、莉拉，然后是他自己。

sentences.en: Tony would bury their bodies and afterwards take his own life.
sentences.zh: 托尼将埋葬他们的尸体，随后自杀。

sentences.en: Charon attempted to deter Simon from the horrifying plan, stating that if he supplied the drug to his young daughter Leela, he would be murdering her.
sentences.zh: 沙龙试图劝阻西蒙放弃这个可怕的计划，称如果他把药物提供给年轻的女儿莉拉，他就是在谋杀她。

sentences.en: Simon agreed and appeared to change his mind.
sentences.zh: 西蒙表示同意，并且似乎改变了主意。

sentences.en: He said his family might instead just wander off and live in isolation, hatching a plan to relocate to Brazil.
sentences.zh: 他说他的家人或许可以只是四处游荡并在孤立中生活，并酝酿了一个搬到巴西的计划。

sentences.en: After learning of this online conversation,
sentences.zh: 在得知这次网络对话后，

sentences.en: Police were immediately concerned for the welfare of Chantelle, Leela and Tony.
sentences.zh: 警方立即开始担忧尚泰尔、莉拉和托尼的安危。

sentences.en: Had Simon gone through with his plan of group suicide?
sentences.zh: 西蒙真的付诸实施了他集体自杀的计划吗？

sentences.zh: “案件档案”稍后回归。

sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持“案件档案”继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: A task force named Operation Omega was created to investigate the disappearance of the family.
sentences.zh: 一个名为“欧米茄行动”的专案组成立，以调查这家人的失踪事件。

sentences.en: Investigating detectives obtained phone records for the family members and noticed some confusing activity.
sentences.zh: 调查侦探获取了家庭成员的通话记录，并注意到一些令人困惑的活动。

sentences.en: On July 12, the day before the family drove to Busselton to sell Chantel's car, a phone call was made from their house to Trans WA, the Western Australian Rail and Bus Service.
sentences.zh: 7月12日，即这家人开车前往巴瑟尔顿出售尚泰尔汽车的前一天，有人从他们家中打出一通电话给西澳铁路和巴士服务公司TransWA。

sentences.en: During the call, a bus ticket was purchased.
sentences.zh: 通话期间，购买了一张车票。

sentences.en: The ticket was for a trip departing from the inland town of Bridgetown, almost 50 kilometres east of Nanum.
sentences.zh: 该车票是一趟从内陆城镇布里奇敦出发的行程，该镇位于纳纳姆以东近50公里处。

sentences.en: The arrival location was almost 100 kilometres south to the beachside town of Northcliffe.
sentences.zh: 抵达地点是向南近100公里处的海滨小镇诺斯克利夫。

sentences.en: The ticket was booked under the name Jay Roberts.
sentences.zh: 车票是以杰伊·罗伯茨的名义预订的。

sentences.en: Further investigation revealed that this bus ticket for Jay Roberts was never used.
sentences.zh: 进一步的调查显示，这张为杰伊·罗伯茨购买的车票从未被使用过。

sentences.en: The day Chantel, Leela and Tony were due to head to Brazil to meet Simon, July 15,
sentences.zh: 在尚泰尔、莉拉和托尼预定前往巴西会合西蒙的日子，即7月15日，

sentences.en: Tony's mobile phone records revealed a call was made from Bunbury, a coastal city approximately 100 kilometres northwest of Nanup.
sentences.zh: 托尼的手机记录显示，有一通电话是从布埠打出的，布埠是位于纳纳普西北约100公里的沿海城市。

sentences.en: Tony's mobile was traced along a train line that reached Perth.
sentences.zh: 托尼的手机沿著一条通往珀斯的铁路线被追踪到。

sentences.en: Another call was made in Perth to a Northbridge hostel called Underground Backpackers.
sentences.zh: 在珀斯又打出了一通电话，打给一家名为地下背包客栈的诺斯布里奇旅舍。

sentences.en: shortly after that call was made a lone man arrived to the hostel and checked into a double
sentences.zh: 在那通电话打出后不久，一名独行男子抵达旅舍，并以托尼·波皮奇的名义登记入住了一间双人

sentences.en: room under the name tony poppich using tony's driver's license as photo id a further two calls
sentences.zh: 房间，使用的是托尼的驾驶证作为照片身份证件。当天晚些时候，

sentences.en: were made that day from tony's mobile the first call was to the court hotel a local gay bar just
sentences.zh: 又从托尼的手机打出了两通电话，第一通打给法庭酒店，一家当地的同性恋酒吧，

sentences.en: 10 minutes walk from the underground backpackers hostel the second call occurred later that night to Domino's Pizza.
sentences.zh: 距离地下背包客栈仅10分钟步行路程，第二通电话在当晚晚些时候打给达美乐比萨。

sentences.en: The caller ordered a pizza to be delivered to King's Park, parkland located alongside Perth's Botanical Gardens, a popular hangout at night due to its proximity to the CBD.
sentences.zh: 来电者点了一份比萨，要求送到国王公园，该公园位于珀斯植物园旁，由于靠近CBD，晚上是一个受欢迎的聚集地。

sentences.en: A delivery driver arrived to the darkened park a short time later.
sentences.zh: 不久后，一名送货司机抵达了黑乎乎的公园。

sentences.en: He described the atmosphere as creepy.
sentences.zh: 他形容那里的气氛令人毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: He gave the pizza to a man and left.
sentences.zh: 他把比萨交给了一个男人然后离开了。

sentences.en: When shown pictures of Simon and Tony, who actually looked somewhat similar,
sentences.zh: 当被出示西蒙和托尼的照片时，这两个人实际上长得有些相似，

sentences.en: The delivery driver pointed out the photograph of Tony as the man he delivered the pizza to that night.
sentences.zh: 送货司机指出了托尼的照片，说这就是他那天晚上送比萨给他的那个男人。

sentences.en: The following morning, on July 16, two more phone calls were made from Tony's mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，即7月16日，托尼的手机又打出了两通电话。

sentences.en: The first call was to TransWA, where a return train ticket was booked from Perth to the inland city of Kalgoorlie, 600 kilometres away.
sentences.zh: 第一通电话打给TransWA，预订了一张从珀斯到600公里外的内陆城市卡尔古利的往返火车票。

sentences.en: This ticket was also booked under the name Jay Roberts.
sentences.zh: 这张票同样是以杰伊·罗伯茨的名义预订的。

sentences.en: The second call was to a taxi service for a ride from the Underground Backpackers Hostel to East Perth train station.
sentences.zh: 第二通电话打给一家出租车服务公司，要求安排一辆车从地下背包客栈前往东珀斯火车站。

sentences.en: The taxi was booked for 6am under the name Tony.
sentences.zh: 出租车是以托尼的名义预订的，时间是早上6点。

sentences.en: The taxi driver took the unidentified passenger to East Perth train station, where he picked up the train ticket to Kalgoorlie on hold for Jay Roberts.
sentences.zh: 出租车司机将这名身份不明的乘客送到东珀斯火车站，他在那里取走了为杰伊·罗伯茨保留的去卡尔古利的火车票。

sentences.en: Another ticket was booked for Jay Roberts that day as well.
sentences.zh: 当天还为杰伊·罗伯茨预订了另一张票。

sentences.en: This won over the phone and paid for at the station in cash.
sentences.zh: 这张是通过电话预订的，并在车站用现金支付。

sentences.en: A one-way trip via train, then bus, from East Perth down to Northcliffe.
sentences.zh: 这是一段从东珀斯经由火车然后转乘巴士单向前往诺斯克利夫的行程。

sentences.en: Around an hour later, at 7am, an unidentified male boarded the train to Kalgoorlie, sitting in car 3, seat 16, on the Prospector train.
sentences.zh: 大约一个小时后，即早上7点，一名身份不明的男子登上了开往卡尔古利的列车，坐在探路者号列车的3号车厢、16号座位上。

sentences.en: It was the seat assigned to Jay Roberts.
sentences.zh: 这就是分配给杰伊·罗伯茨的座位。

sentences.en: Tony's phone was traced moving in the direction of this near six and a half hour trip to Kalgoorlie.
sentences.zh: 托尼的手机被追踪到正朝着这趟近六个半小时的卡尔古利行程方向移动。

sentences.en: After the trip to Kalgoorlie, Tony's phone was never used or traced again.
sentences.zh: 在去过卡尔古利之后，托尼的手机就再也没有被使用过或追踪到了。

sentences.en: It was never confirmed whether the unknown passenger in seat 16 had reached Kalgoorlie or if they had disembarked on one of the 17 stops along the way.
sentences.zh: 始终未能确认16号座位的未知乘客是否真的到达了卡尔古利，或者他们是否在沿途的17个停靠站之一下了车。

sentences.en: It's also never been confirmed if the second ticket that was booked for Jay Roberts, the one-way trip to Northcliffe, was ever used.
sentences.zh: 也从未证实为杰伊·罗伯茨预订的第二张票，即单程前往诺斯克利夫的那张，是否被使用过。

sentences.en: Police were left scratching their heads over
sentences.zh: 警方对

sentences.en: Tony's mobile phone records and the actions of the unknown man referred to as Jay Roberts.
sentences.zh: 托尼的手机记录以及被指称为杰伊·罗伯茨的未知男子的行为感到百思不得其解。

sentences.en: Was it all an elaborate misdirection?
sentences.zh: 这一切是否都是精心设计的误导？

sentences.en: Whatever the case, Tony's phone records provided no answers to what happened to the family and only compounded the already confusing investigation.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，托尼的手机记录没有为这家人发生了什么提供任何答案，反而让本已令人困惑的调查雪上加霜。

sentences.en: In April 2008, nearing the one-year anniversary of the family's disappearance, police appealed to the public for new information that might help determine what
sentences.zh: 在2008年4月，接近这家人失踪一周年之际，警方公开呼吁公众提供新信息，以帮助确定

sentences.en: became of Simon, Chantel, Leela and Tony.
sentences.zh: 西蒙、尚泰尔、莉拉和托尼的下落。

sentences.en: Following the appeal, 30 calls were made to authorities, but no compelling new leads were made.
sentences.zh: 呼吁发出后，当局接到了30通电话，但没有产生任何引人注目的新线索。

sentences.en: One thing police knew but had yet to reveal publicly was that in May 2007, two months before the family disappeared, Nanup police pulled Simon's
sentences.zh: 警方知道但尚未公开披露的一件事是，在2007年5月，即这家人失踪前两个月，纳纳普警方在一次例行交通拦车检查中拦下了西蒙的

sentences.en: car over during a routine traffic stop.
sentences.zh: 汽车。

sentences.en: Simon was in the car alone.
sentences.zh: 西蒙独自在车里。

sentences.en: When police asked him to show identification, Simon became unusually agitated and nervous by the simple requeSt.
sentences.zh: 当警察要求他出示身份证件时，面对这个简单的要求，西蒙变得异常激动和紧张。

sentences.en: It was no secret at this point that Simon Cadwell used multiple aliases throughout his life.
sentences.zh: 此时已不是秘密，西蒙·卡德威尔一生中曾使用过多个化名。

sentences.en: Aside from his online username Sy in the forecourt forums for the Truth Fellowship, he also used the names Simon Cadwill and Simon Keddy.
sentences.zh: 除了他在真理团契前庭论坛上的网络用户名Sy之外，他还使用过西蒙·卡德维尔和西蒙·凯迪这两个名字。

sentences.en: Australian authorities put out a call to
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚当局向

sentences.en: Interpol for Simon Cadwell and all his known aliases.
sentences.zh: 国际刑警组织发出了针对西蒙·卡德威尔及其所有已知化名的通缉令。

sentences.en: Their hope was, if Simon had relocated to another country, they'd be able to find him.
sentences.zh: 他们的希望是，如果西蒙已经搬到了另一个国家，他们就能找到他。

sentences.en: They had no idea that this line of inquiry would result in a revelation that would change everything.
sentences.zh: 他们当时并不知道，这条调查路线将带来一个将改变一切的重大发现。

sentences.en: In September 2009, approximately two years after the family disappeared, an immigration officer at Heathrow Airport in
sentences.zh: 2009年9月，大约在这家人失踪两年后，伦敦希思罗机场的

sentences.en: London received an alert on his system for Simon Cadwell.
sentences.zh: 一名移民官员在他的系统上收到了关于西蒙·卡德威尔的警报。

sentences.en: Simon was attempting to exit the country.
sentences.zh: 西蒙正试图离开该国。

sentences.en: country.
sentences.zh: 国家。

sentences.en: When the immigration officer compared the photograph Australian authorities had shared of
sentences.zh: 当移民官员将澳大利亚当局分享的西蒙·卡德威尔的照片与

sentences.en: Simon Cadwell to the man attempting to leave Heathrow, it was clear they were two completely different men.
sentences.zh: 试图离开希思罗机场的男子进行比对时，很明显他们是两个完全不同的人。

sentences.en: But that didn't stop the immigration officer from asking a few questions.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有阻止移民官员问几个问题。

sentences.en: Even though it was clear he definitely wasn't the Simon Cadwell they were looking for, he did manage to drop a bombshell that shook the entire investigation.
sentences.zh: 尽管很明显他绝对不是他们在寻找的那个西蒙·卡德威尔，但他确实抛出了一个震撼整个调查的重磅炸弹。

sentences.en: When shown a photograph of the Simon Cadwell Australian authorities were after, the Simon Cadwell at Heathrow Airport responded,
sentences.zh: 当被出示澳大利亚当局追捕的西蒙·卡德威尔的照片时，希思罗机场的西蒙·卡德威尔回应道：

sentences.en: I know that man, and his name isn't Simon.
sentences.zh: “我认识那个人，他不叫西蒙。”

sentences.en: Simon Cadwell, the leader of the Truth Fellowship, partner to Chantel, father of Leela,
sentences.zh: 真理团契的领导者、尚泰尔的伴侣、莉拉的父亲西蒙·卡德威尔，

sentences.en: was actually a man called Gary Felton.
sentences.zh: 其实是一个名叫加里·费尔顿的人。

sentences.en: Gary Felton was born in the United Kingdom in 1962.
sentences.zh: 加里·费尔顿于1962年出生于英国。

sentences.en: The real Simon Cadwell, the man picked up at Heathrow Airport, had met Gary Felton when the two attended the same British university in the early 90s.
sentences.zh: 真正的西蒙·卡德威尔，也就是在希思罗机场被拦截的那个人，是在90年代初两人上同一所英国大学时认识加里·费尔顿的。

sentences.en: During this time, Gary Felton stole
sentences.zh: 正是在这段时间里，加里·费尔顿偷走了

sentences.en: Simon Cadwell's birth certificate.
sentences.zh: 西蒙·卡德韦尔的出生证明。

sentences.en: Simon had no idea why Gary had done so, but now his motive was clear.
sentences.zh: 西蒙起初并不明白加里为什么要这么做，但现在他的动机已经昭然若揭。

sentences.en: Gary had used the birth certificate to assume Simon's identity.
sentences.zh: 加里利用这张出生证明冒用了西蒙的身份。

sentences.en: Police now realised they were dealing with a long-running professional fraudster.
sentences.zh: 警方现在意识到，他们面对的是一名作案多年、手法老练的职业诈骗犯。

sentences.en: Gary Felton had not only plagiarised his spiritual books to create his own cult, but he had deceived every single person who knew him as Simon Cadwell.
sentences.zh: 加里·费尔顿不仅剽窃自己的灵修书籍来建立邪教，还欺骗了所有认识“西蒙·卡德韦尔”的人。

sentences.en: What had Gary Felton done that compelled him to assume another man's identity?
sentences.zh: 加里·费尔顿究竟做了什么，逼得他不得不冒用另一个男人的身份？

sentences.en: Police felt there was a strong possibility Gary Felton had assumed yet another man's identity since his disappearance and was managing to evade authorities by travelling
sentences.zh: 警方认为，极有可能是加里·费尔顿在失踪后又冒用了另一个男人的身份，并通过使用

sentences.en: under his new, unknown alias.
sentences.zh: 他全新且不为人知的化名四处游走，从而成功逃避了当局的追捕。

sentences.en: Chantelle McDougal's parents recalled seeing Gary, who at the time they believed was Simon, receive a passport in the mail.
sentences.zh: 尚泰尔·麦克杜格尔的父母回忆说，他们曾看到加里——他们当时以为那是西蒙——在信箱里收到了一本护照。

sentences.en: Jim and Kath McDougal were told the passport was for Leela.
sentences.zh: 吉姆和凯思·麦克杜格尔被告知，这本护照是给莉拉的。

sentences.en: Now, police considered it might have been another one of Gary's false passports.
sentences.zh: 如今，警方认为这可能是加里拥有的又一本假护照。

sentences.en: Maybe he had obtained fake passports for Chantelle, Leela and Tony as well.
sentences.zh: 也许他也为尚泰尔、莉拉和托尼弄到了假护照。

sentences.en: They all could have snuck out of Australia under false identities.
sentences.zh: 他们完全有可能使用假身份偷偷溜出澳大利亚。

sentences.en: It wasn't an impossible act.
sentences.zh: 这并非不可能做到。

sentences.en: A report conducted by Australia's Daily Telegraph newspaper in the 18 months following the family's disappearance revealed passport forgery was alive and well.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚《每日电讯报》在这一家人失踪后的18个月内进行的一项调查报道显示，护照伪造在当时依然十分猖獗。

sentences.en: Between 2005 and
sentences.zh: 仅在2005至

sentences.en: 2006 alone, 223 false Australian passports were intercepted worldwide at various country entry points.
sentences.zh: 2006年期间，世界各地各个国家的入境口岸就截获了223本虚假的澳大利亚护照。

sentences.en: 118 of those were intercepted in Australia.
sentences.zh: 其中118本是在澳大利亚境内被截获的。

sentences.en: Figures between 2007 and 2008, the time when the family went missing, were fairly similar.
sentences.zh: 2007年至2008年（即该家庭失踪的时期）的数据也与之相差无几。

sentences.en: Numerous shady websites offer fake passports for as little as $1,250.
sentences.zh: 许多声誉可疑的网站以低至1250美元的价格出售假护照。

sentences.en: They promise to feature any country stamps requested, along with a guaranteed success to pass all existing passport confirmation tests, including UV tests and machine-readable
sentences.zh: 他们承诺会印上任何要求的国家印章，并保证能顺利通过所有现有的护照验证测试，包括紫外线测试和机器可读

sentences.en: zone checks.
sentences.zh: 区检查。

sentences.en: It wasn't a stretch to assume professional conman Gary Felton, who spent most of his waking time on his computer, may have come across one of these sites and made a purchase.
sentences.zh: 不难想象，把醒着的大部分时间都花在电脑上的职业骗子加里·费尔顿，很有可能偶然发现了其中一个网站并完成了购买。

sentences.en: By 2010, there were still no leads into the whereabouts of Gary Felton,
sentences.zh: 直到2010年，关于加里·费尔顿、

sentences.en: Chantel McDougall, her daughter Leela, or Tony Poppich.
sentences.zh: 尚泰尔·麦克杜格尔、她的女儿莉拉或托尼·波皮奇的下落依然线索全无。

sentences.en: Chantel's parents embarked on a three month trip from their home in Victoria, 4,000 kilometres north to Cape York in far north
sentences.zh: 尚泰尔的父母从维多利亚州的家中出发，踏上了为期三个月的旅程，向北行驶4000公里，一直来到极北的

sentences.en: Queensland, distributing 1,000 flyers featuring Chantel's and Leela's details along the way.
sentences.zh: 昆士兰州约克角，沿途散发了1000份印有尚泰尔和莉拉信息的传单。

sentences.en: Police maintained their search, but now they weren't attempting to zero in on the name
sentences.zh: 警方一直在继续搜寻，但他们现在锁定的不再是

sentences.en: Simon Cadwell.
sentences.zh: “西蒙·卡德韦尔”这个名字。

sentences.en: Their sights were set on the name Gary Felton, and in a similar vein,
sentences.zh: 他们的目标转向了加里·费尔顿，同样地，

sentences.en: Jay Roberts, the name used to purchase train and bus tickets across Western Australia shortly after the family's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 还有杰伊·罗伯茨——这个名字是在这家人失踪后不久，用来购买穿梭于西澳大利亚州的火车票和汽车票的。

sentences.en: It seemed likely that Jay Roberts was yet another false identity created by Gary.
sentences.zh: 杰伊·罗伯茨很可能只是加里捏造的又一个假身份。

sentences.en: The scope of the investigation was narrowed in on Australia, as there had been no evidence suggesting the family ever left the country.
sentences.zh: 调查范围缩小到了澳大利亚境内，因为没有证据表明这家人曾经离开过该国。

sentences.en: However, with the realisation Gary Felton had knowledge and experience using fake passports, the possibility the family had followed through with their plan to head to Brazil
sentences.zh: 然而，随着人们意识到加里·费尔顿拥有使用假护照的知识和经验，这家人前往巴西的计划

sentences.en: was now a worthwhile consideration.
sentences.zh: 现在被认为是一个值得认真考虑的可能性。

sentences.en: The peculiar mystery had gained media attention and became an obsession for online sleuths, who began to conduct their own research into what may have happened to the family.
sentences.zh: 这起离奇的悬案引发了媒体的关注，并成了网络侦探们的执念，他们开始自行调查这家人究竟遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: Their research led to a disturbing discovery.
sentences.zh: 他们的调查却带来了一个令人不安的发现。

sentences.en: On the night of July 17, 2007, four days after Chantel was last seen,
sentences.zh: 2007年7月17日夜里，即尚泰尔最后一次露面四天后，

sentences.en: TN Airlines' domestic flight 3054 departed Porto Alegre with 181 passengers and six crew members on board.
sentences.zh: TN航空公司的3054国内航班从阿雷格里港起飞，机上载有181名乘客和6名机组人员。

sentences.en: The flight was destined for Sao Paulo.
sentences.zh: 该航班的目的地是圣保罗。

sentences.en: Weather was particularly bad during the flight.
sentences.zh: 飞行期间天气格外恶劣。

sentences.en: The runway at Sao Paulo was noted as incredibly wet and slippery.
sentences.zh: 据记载，圣保罗的跑道异常湿滑。

sentences.en: During the approach, the plane's pilot remarked he had a headache.
sentences.zh: 在进近降落时，飞机机长曾抱怨说他头痛。

sentences.en: It's believed his headache, along with the problematic weather and slippery runway, impacted his ability to land the plane.
sentences.zh: 人们认为，他的头痛再加上糟糕的天气和湿滑的跑道，影响了他平稳降落飞机的能力。

sentences.en: As the plane touched down, it slid down the runway and crossed over a major road.
sentences.zh: 当飞机触地时，它在跑道上滑行并冲过了一条主要公路。

sentences.en: Moments later, it collided with a fuel service station, causing the aircraft to burst into flames.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，它撞上了一处燃料加油站，导致飞机起火燃烧。

sentences.en: The resulting fireball burned uncontrollably for several hours.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的大火熊熊燃烧了几个小时，无法扑灭。

sentences.en: This led to a number of bodies never being able to be identified or recovered from the wreckage.
sentences.zh: 这导致许多遗体根本无法从残骸中辨认或寻获。

sentences.en: Questions were raised as to whether Gary Felton, Chantel McDougal,
sentences.zh: 人们开始怀疑加里·费尔顿、尚泰尔·麦克杜格尔、

sentences.en: Lila McDougal or Tony Poppich had been on this flight using assumed identities and fake passports.
sentences.zh: 莉拉·麦克杜格尔或托尼·波皮奇是否曾使用假名和假护照搭乘过这架航班。

sentences.en: The crash occurred 80 hours after the last sighting of Chantel.
sentences.zh: 坠机事故发生在尚泰尔最后一次露面80小时之后。

sentences.en: It was possible timing-wise for her and the others to have been on the flight, even taking into account stopovers that may have prolonged their journey to Brazil.
sentences.zh: 从时间上来看，她和其他人完全有可能搭乘了这架航班，即使考虑到可能延长了他们前往巴西行程的中转时间。

sentences.en: However, Western Australian police and Brazilian authorities have reached the conclusion that none of the missing four were on board the doomed flight.
sentences.zh: 然而，西澳大利亚警方和巴西当局得出的结论是，这四名失踪人员都不在失事的航班上。

sentences.en: there was a conclusion the families of Chantelle McDougall and Tony Pockage agreed with.
sentences.zh: 这一结论得到了尚泰尔·麦克杜格尔和托尼·波基奇家属的赞同。

sentences.en: They maintained the belief that the family were still in Australia and were living remotely under new identities.
sentences.zh: 他们坚信这家人仍然在澳大利亚，并在某个偏远地区隐姓埋名地生活。

sentences.en: In March 2012, five years after the family disappeared, horses grazing in a paddock in Nanup disturbed human remains and clothing.
sentences.zh: 2012年3月，这家人失踪五年后，在纳努普的一处围场吃草的马匹惊动了人类遗骸和衣物。

sentences.en: It was believed the remains, consisting of bones and a skull, were previously submerged when the farmland was swampy.
sentences.zh: 据信，这些由骨骼和头骨组成的遗骸以前在农田成为沼泽时曾被淹没过。

sentences.en: Police rushed the remains for forensic testing, which revealed they belonged to a 62-year-old Victorian man, missing since 2003.
sentences.zh: 警方紧急将遗骸送去进行法医鉴定，结果显示它们属于一名自2003年起失踪的62岁维多利亚州男子。

sentences.en: In July 2015, the decomposed remains of a female child were discovered in a tattered suitcase on the side of a rural South Australian highway.
sentences.zh: 2015年7月，南澳大利亚州一条乡村公路旁的一个破旧手提箱里，发现了儿童女性的腐烂遗骸。

sentences.en: Testing confirmed the girl had been deceased since around 2007, and the discovery was near several desolate communities of people living off the grid.
sentences.zh: 检测证实，这个女孩大约从2007年起就已经死亡，而且发现地点附近有几个与世隔绝的隐居人群社区。

sentences.en: Due to the time frame and location, there was a strong possibility the girl in the suitcase might have been Leela.
sentences.zh: 鉴于时间框架和地理位置，手提箱里的女孩很有可能是莉拉。

sentences.en: But in October 2015, the girl was positively identified.
sentences.zh: 但在2015年10月，这名女孩的身份得到了确切确认。

sentences.en: It wasn't Leela.
sentences.zh: 她并不是莉拉。

sentences.en: In November 2016, nine years after the family disappeared, a young, homeless, English-speaking teenager was found wandering the streets of Rome in Italy.
sentences.zh: 2016年11月，这家人失踪九年后，意大利罗马街头出现了一个流浪的、说英语的年轻少女。

sentences.en: The girl offered various names, making it difficult for people to identify her.
sentences.zh: 这个女孩报出了各种不同的名字，给人们确认她的身份造成了困难。

sentences.en: Australian authorities held out hope the teenage girl was Leela.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚当局仍然抱有一线希望，期盼这个少女就是莉拉。

sentences.en: When shown a picture of the teenager, Kath and Jim McDougall, Leela's grandparents, weren't convinced it was her.
sentences.zh: 当莉拉的祖父母凯思和吉姆·麦克杜格尔看到这个少女的照片时，他们并不确信那就是她。

sentences.en: They were later proven right.
sentences.zh: 事实证明他们后来是对的。

sentences.en: The teenage girl found in Rome, was identified as a runaway from Sweden.
sentences.zh: 在罗马发现的这个少女，被证实是一名来自瑞典的离家出走者。

sentences.en: In mid-May 2017, ten years after the disappearance of Chantelle McDougall, her daughter Leela, Tony Poppich and Gary Felton, the Western Australian
sentences.zh: 2017年5月中旬，在尚泰尔·麦克杜格尔、她的女儿莉拉、托尼·波皮奇和加里·费尔顿失踪十年之际，西澳大利亚州

sentences.en: Coroner's Office announced they would hold an inquest into the suspected deaths of the group of four.
sentences.zh: 验尸官办公室宣布将对这四人的疑似死亡事件举行听证会。

sentences.en: It was a long time coming for Jim and Kath McDougall, who had been petitioning for an inquest since 2011.
sentences.zh: 对于自2011年以来一直请愿要求举行听证会的吉姆和凯思·麦克杜格尔来说，这一天可谓期盼已久。

sentences.en: Jim McDougall, quote, We would like some final decision.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·麦克杜格尔原话：“我们希望有一个最终的裁决。”

sentences.en: If it's an open finding, then it is what it is.
sentences.zh: “如果是个开放式裁决，那就这样吧。”

sentences.en: It would be so much of a relief to find out what happened, whether it's good or bad.
sentences.zh: “无论结果是好是坏，能查明真相将是一种巨大的解脱。”

sentences.en: It's the not knowing that's horrible.
sentences.zh: “这种一无所知的状态才是最可怕的。”

sentences.en: In December 2017,
Coroner Barry King began proceedings in the Western Australian town of Busselton, the last location the entire family were seen alive together, where they sold Chantel's car.
sentences.zh: 验尸官巴里·金在西澳大利亚州的巴瑟尔顿镇开始了法律程序，这是整个家庭最后一次被看到活在一起、并卖掉尚泰尔汽车的地方。

sentences.en: Gary Felton was exposed as the conman he had always been, someone who chose his followers
sentences.zh: 加里·费尔顿作为一个骗子的真面目被彻底揭穿，他一直是个懂得

sentences.en: wisely, easily manipulating them to believe in him and using this power to disassociate them from mainstream society.
sentences.zh: 明智挑选信徒的人，能轻易操纵他们去信任自己，并利用这种权力将他们与主流社会隔绝开来。

sentences.en: A criminal behavioural psychologist defined Gary Felton as a narcissistic conman who used isolation to control his group.
sentences.zh: 一名犯罪行为心理学家将加里·费尔顿定义为一个自恋的骗子，他通过孤立来控制自己的团伙。

sentences.en: He boasted to be above the constraints of human existence when in reality he spent his time sleeping and engrossed in his computer while
sentences.zh: 他吹嘘自己超脱于人类生存的束缚，而现实中他把时间都花在睡觉和沉迷电脑上，

sentences.en: his girlfriend worked three jobs to maintain his apathetic lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 他的女友则要打三份工来维持他这种毫无进取心的生活方式。

sentences.en: It was little wonder that someone like Gary Felton, described as a controlling, manipulative cult leader, was able
sentences.zh: 难怪像加里·费尔顿这样被描述为具有控制欲和操纵欲的邪教头目，能够

sentences.en: to tighten his grip around people like Chantelle McDougall and Tony Poppich, who were both described
sentences.zh: 牢牢掌控像尚泰尔·麦克杜格尔和托尼·波皮奇这样的人——他们都被形容为

sentences.en: as kind and generous, the kind of people who were out to please, and therefore, were easily influenced.
sentences.zh: 善良而慷慨，是那种一心想取悦他人、因此极易受到影响的人。

sentences.en: The inquest revealed police had received several reports of sightings of members of the family after their disappearance, but these reports were not followed up on at the time
sentences.zh: 听证会透露，警方在失踪事件发生后曾接到数起目击该家庭成员的报告，但由于当时缺乏证据，

sentences.en: due to a lack of evidence.
sentences.zh: 这些报告并未得到跟进调查。

sentences.en: Additionally, three months after the disappearance, prison workers found a woman's t-shirt in bushland near Northcliffe,
sentences.zh: 此外，在失踪三个月后，监狱工人在诺思克利夫附近的灌木丛中发现了一件女式T恤，

sentences.en: a location that was featured prominently throughout the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这个地点在整个调查过程中曾多次受到关注。

sentences.en: According to those who found it, the t-shirt smelled of dead flesh.
sentences.zh: 据发现者称，这件T恤散发着腐肉的气味。

sentences.en: This report was not fully investigated by authorities until eight years later.
sentences.zh: 这一报告直到八年后才受到当局的全面调查。

sentences.en: By then, bushfires had swept through the area, destroying any evidence that may have led to the t-shirt's owner.
sentences.zh: 到那时，山火已经席卷了该地区，摧毁了所有可能指向这件T恤主人的证据。

sentences.en: Furthermore, items rumoured to have been Chantelle McDougal's were discovered at the
sentences.zh: 此外，据传属于尚泰尔·麦克杜格尔的物品在

sentences.en: Nanup rubbish tip, but police never recovered them.
sentences.zh: 纳努普垃圾场被发现，但警方从未将其寻回。

sentences.en: The landlords of the property in Nanup appeared at the inqueSt. They had visited the house often when the family were still living there.
sentences.zh: 纳努普房产的房东出席了听证会。在这家人还在那里生活时，他们曾频繁造访这所房子。

sentences.en: They described Chantel McDougall as a hard-working, practical, and loving mother, and Tony Poppich as polite.
sentences.zh: 他们将尚泰尔·麦克杜格尔描述为一位勤劳、务实且慈爱的母亲，而托尼·波皮奇则很有礼貌。

sentences.en: They were the perfect tenants.
sentences.zh: 他们是完美的租户。

sentences.en: One of the landlords recalled running into Chantel and Leela in town.
sentences.zh: 其中一位房东回忆说曾在镇上碰见尚泰尔和莉拉。

sentences.en: Chantel explained that she couldn't go home yet, as Simon had clients.
sentences.zh: 尚泰尔解释说她还不能回家，因为西蒙有客户要接待。

sentences.en: But she never elaborated on what that meant.
sentences.zh: 但她从未详细说明那具体意味着什么。

sentences.en: When asked to describe the person she knew was Simon Cadwell, real name Gary Felton,
sentences.zh: 当被要求描述她所认识的那个西蒙·卡德韦尔（真名加里·费尔顿）时，

sentences.en: the landlord described a clueless and impractical man who, from her perspective, completely dominated the household he desperately relied on.
